The FloPlast 112mm half round internal stop end is a robust uPVC component designed for effective rainwater drainage systems. This black gutter stop end provides a secure and reliable seal, essential for directing water efficiently from roofs. It is ideal for both new construction and gutter refurbishment projects, offering compatibility with many major manufacturers' half-round guttering. Featuring an easy to install system, this durable stop end includes a pre-fitted gutter seal retaining clip, ensuring a long-lasting connection for various properties.
